words.definition: n. 特许经营权；加盟店；（美）职业球队；vt. 授予特许权

examples.en: She bought a fast-food franchise and opened three outlets within a year.
examples.zh: 她买下一家快餐品牌特许经营权，一年内开了三家门店。

examples.en: Many young entrepreneurs start out by running a small franchise.
examples.zh: 许多年轻创业者从经营小型加盟店起步。

words.usage: 商业高频：franchise fee 加盟费、buy a franchise 买下特许经营权、franchise store 加盟店。派生：franchisee n. 加盟商，franchisor n. 授权方，一对术语配套记。美式引申指系列电影、职业球队：a movie franchise 系列电影 IP。
collocations: franchise fee 加盟费
fast-food franchise 快餐特许经营
buy a franchise 购买特许经营权
words.mnemonic: 源自法语「自由」→ 自由授权他人开店 → 特许经营

words.definition: vt. 浸没，淹没；vi. 潜入水中；埋头于

examples.en: The submarine submerged to avoid detection by enemy radar.
examples.zh: 潜艇潜入水下，以躲避敌方雷达探测。

examples.en: After the tragedy, she submerged herself in research work.
examples.zh: 悲剧发生后，她把自己埋进了研究工作里。

words.usage: 本义浸没、潜入水中：be submerged in water 淹没水中；引申沉浸或被压垮：be submerged in work 埋头工作、be submerged by debt 深陷债务。派生：submergence n. 淹没；submersible adj. 可潜水的，n. 潜水器。与 immerse 近，后者多用于抽象沉浸。
collocations: be submerged in water 淹没水中
submerged rocks 暗礁
be submerged in work 埋头工作
words.mnemonic: sub（下）+merge（沉）→ 沉到水下 → 淹没

words.definition: vt. 增加，增补，扩充

examples.en: The professor augmented his income by reviewing textbooks.
examples.zh: 教授靠评审教材来增加收入。

examples.en: The hospital augmented its staff with volunteer nurses during the crisis.
examples.zh: 危机期间，这家医院用志愿护士来补充人手。

words.usage: 正式用语，指在原有基础上增补：augment one's income 贴补收入、augment the water supply 扩充供水。科技热词 augmented reality（AR）增强现实。派生：augmentation n. 增补，扩大。注意与 argument（争论）拼写仅差一个 e。
collocations: augment income 增加收入
augmented reality 增强现实
augment the supply 增补供应
words.mnemonic: aug（增）+ment → 增补；argument 争论少个 e 别混

words.definition: n. 芽，花蕾；vi. 发芽，含苞待放

examples.en: The first green buds appeared on the branches in early March.
examples.zh: 三月初，枝头冒出了第一批嫩芽。

examples.en: The roses are just beginning to bud despite the cold snap.
examples.zh: 尽管寒流来袭，玫瑰已开始含苞待放。

words.usage: in bud 含苞待放；习语 nip sth in the bud 字面「掐灭在芽期」，即防患于未然，考研高频短语。派生：budding adj. 崭露头角的：a budding writer 文坛新秀。形近词 buddy n. 伙伴，与 bud 无词源关联但可联想记忆。
collocations: nip sth in the bud 防患于未然
in bud 含苞待放
a budding writer 崭露头角的作家
words.mnemonic: 谐音「苞的」→ 花苞 → 芽；nip in the bud 掐芽防患

words.definition: n. 框架；体格；vt. 给…装框；陷害；构想

examples.en: The project must be completed within the agreed time frame.
examples.zh: 该项目必须在商定的时间范围内完成。

examples.en: The defendants claimed they had been framed by corrupt officials.
examples.zh: 被告们声称自己遭到了腐败官员的陷害。

words.usage: 多义高频词：a picture frame 相框；time frame 时限、时间范围，阅读常见；be framed for sth 被诬陷犯某罪；frame a question 组织措辞提问。派生：framework n. 框架、体系，学术写作必备：theoretical framework 理论框架。
collocations: time frame 时间范围
picture frame 相框
be framed for murder 被诬陷谋杀
words.mnemonic: fame（名声）+r（框）→ 装进框里 → 框架；framework 由此来

words.definition: n. 草稿；征兵；汇票；vt. 起草；征召

examples.en: The committee has published a first draft of the new regulations.
examples.zh: 委员会已公布新条例的初稿。

examples.en: He was drafted into the army shortly after his eighteenth birthday.
examples.zh: 刚过完十八岁生日不久，他就应征入伍了。

words.usage: 核心义草稿、起草：a rough draft 初稿、draft a contract 起草合同。美式 the draft 指征兵制：be drafted into the army 应征入伍。金融义 draft 汇票：bank draft 银行汇票。英式拼写 draught 另指穿堂风，须分清。
collocations: a rough draft 草稿
draft a contract 起草合同
bank draft 银行汇票
words.mnemonic: d+raft（木排）→ 先搭架子 → 草稿；craft 是手艺

words.definition: adj. 真实的，正宗的；可靠的

examples.en: The museum displays authentic artifacts from ancient Egypt.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出古埃及的真品文物。

examples.en: Tourists flock to the old town in search of authentic local life.
examples.zh: 游客们涌向老城，寻找地道的本地生活。

words.usage: 指真品、正宗、可靠：an authentic signature 亲笔签名、authentic Italian food 正宗意大利菜。派生：authenticity n. 真实性：question the authenticity of the document；authenticate vt. 鉴定为真。authoritative 指「权威的」，注意区分。
collocations: authentic cuisine 正宗菜肴
authentic document 真实文件
authentic experience 真实体验
words.mnemonic: author（作者）亲证的 → 真品、正宗的

words.definition: v. 剥去，剥光；剥夺；n. 条，带；狭长地带

examples.en: The refugees were stripped of all their belongings at the border.
examples.zh: 难民们在边境被剥夺了全部财物。

examples.en: He tore the letter into strips and threw them into the bin.
examples.zh: 他把信撕成细条，扔进了垃圾桶。

words.usage: 高频搭配 strip sb of sth 剥夺某人职位、权利：be stripped of the title 被剥夺头衔。名词指细长条：a strip of land 狭长地带，如 the Gaza Strip 加沙地带。派生：stripe n. 条纹；stripped adj. 被剥光的；strip mining 露天采矿。
collocations: strip sb of sth 剥夺某人的权利
a strip of land 狭长地带
strip off 脱掉衣服
words.mnemonic: strip 剥、strap 带、stripe 纹：结尾 p 是剥，pe 是纹

words.definition: n. 鼓；圆桶；v. 有节奏地敲击

examples.en: He drummed his fingers on the table while waiting for the result.
examples.zh: 等结果时，他用手指在桌上咚咚地敲。

examples.en: The oil was stored in large steel drums at the back of the factory.
examples.zh: 石油储存在工厂后面的大钢桶里。

words.usage: 本义鼓：beat the drums 击鼓；引申有节奏地敲：drum one's fingers on the desk。短语 drum sth into sb 反复灌输；drum up support or business 拉支持、揽生意。容器义指圆桶：an oil drum 油桶，新闻中 oil drum 极常见。
collocations: drum up support 争取支持
oil drum 油桶
drum sth into sb 向某人反复灌输
words.mnemonic: 拟声「咚咚」→ drum 鼓；圆桶敲起来也咚咚响

words.definition: n. 资格证书，资历；证明书；国书

examples.en: Applicants must submit their academic credentials with the application form.
examples.zh: 申请者须随申请表提交学历证明。

examples.en: Her credentials as an economist are beyond question.
examples.zh: 她作为经济学家的资历毋庸置疑。

words.usage: 几乎总以复数出现：check sb's credentials 核查资历、academic credentials 学历资质、present one's credentials 出示证书。外交语境指国书。词根 cred 表「相信」，同族 credit 信用、credible 可信的、creditor 债权人，可一串记牢。
collocations: check one's credentials 核查资历
academic credentials 学历证明
present credentials 出示证件
words.mnemonic: cred（相信）+entials → 让人信的凭证 → 资历

words.definition: n. 潜艇；adj. 海底的，水下的

examples.en: The nuclear submarine remained undetected beneath the surface for weeks.
examples.zh: 那艘核潜艇在水下潜伏数周未被发现。

examples.en: Submarine cables carry over ninety percent of intercontinental data traffic.
examples.zh: 海底电缆承载着九成以上的洲际数据流量。

words.usage: 名词潜水艇，口语缩作 sub。形容词义「水下的」：submarine cable 海底电缆，科技阅读高频，全球九成以上洲际数据经其传输；submarine volcano 海底火山。构词 sub-（下）+marine（海的），同族 submerge、maritime 海事的。
collocations: nuclear submarine 核潜艇
submarine cable 海底电缆
submarine warfare 潜艇战
words.mnemonic: sub（下）+marine（海的）→ 海面之下 → 潜艇

words.definition: v. 嗡嗡叫；哼曲子；n. 嗡嗡声；繁忙嘈杂

examples.en: She hummed a familiar tune while cooking dinner.
examples.zh: 做晚饭时，她哼着一支熟悉的曲子。

examples.en: The office hummed with activity ahead of the product launch.
examples.zh: 产品发布前，办公室里一片热火朝天的嗡嗡声。

words.usage: 拟态动词：bees hum 蜜蜂嗡嗡、the fridge hums 冰箱低鸣。短语 hum with sth 充满声响与活力：The city hummed with life 城市生机勃勃。口语 hum and haw 支支吾吾、吞吞吐吐。派生：hummingbird n. 蜂鸟；hummed 双写 m，拼写常错。
collocations: hum a tune 哼小曲
hum with life 生机盎然
hum and haw 支支吾吾
words.mnemonic: 拟声「哼——」→ hum 哼曲、机器嗡嗡

words.definition: n. 欺诈，诈骗；骗子；赝品

examples.en: He was arrested for tax fraud involving millions of dollars.
examples.zh: 他因涉及数百万美元的骗税案被捕。

examples.en: The so-called investment expert turned out to be a fraud.
examples.zh: 那位所谓的投资专家最后被证明是个彻头彻尾的骗子。

words.usage: 法律财经高频：commit fraud 实施诈骗；tax、insurance、identity fraud 骗税、保险欺诈、冒用身份。可数时指骗子、赝品：This painting is a fraud 这幅画是赝品。派生：fraudulent adj. 欺诈的：fraudulent claims 欺诈性索赔；defraud vt. 骗取。
collocations: commit fraud 实施诈骗
tax fraud 骗税
insurance fraud 保险欺诈
words.mnemonic: fraud 谐音「富饶的」→ 骗局许你富饶，实则掏空钱包

words.definition: v. 广播，播放；散布；n. 广播节目

examples.en: The ceremony was broadcast live to more than fifty countries.
examples.zh: 典礼向五十多个国家进行了现场直播。

examples.en: The state broadcaster refused to broadcast the controversial interview.
examples.zh: 国家广播公司拒绝播出那段有争议的采访。

words.usage: 本义广播、播出：broadcast live 现场直播，过去式与过去分词同形 broadcast，同 cut、put 型。引申四处散布消息，多含贬义：broadcast one's problems 到处诉苦。派生：broadcaster n. 播音员；广播公司；broadcasting n. 广播业。
collocations: broadcast live 现场直播
live broadcast 直播节目
news broadcast 新闻广播
words.mnemonic: broad（广）+cast（投）→ 撒向四面八方 → 广播

words.definition: n. 标准，准则（复数 criteria）

examples.en: What criteria do you use to evaluate a research paper?
examples.zh: 你们用什么标准来评价一篇科研论文？

examples.en: Price should not be the sole criterion for choosing a supplier.
examples.zh: 价格不应是选择供应商的唯一标准。

words.usage: 单数 criterion，复数 criteria，源自希腊语，切勿把 criteria 误作单数，写作常见错误。搭配 meet the criteria 达标、evaluation criteria 评估标准、the sole criterion 唯一标准。近义 standard 最通用，criterion 强调评判依据。
collocations: meet the criteria 达到标准
evaluation criterion 评估标准
sole criterion 唯一标准
words.mnemonic: 希腊词尾：criterion→criteria，同 phenomenon→phenomena

words.definition: n. 假说，假设，前提（复数 hypotheses）

examples.en: The experiment was designed to test the original hypothesis.
examples.zh: 该实验旨在验证最初的假设。

examples.en: The data failed to support his hypothesis about climate patterns.
examples.zh: 这些数据未能支持他关于气候模式的假说。

words.usage: 科研阅读核心词：put forward a hypothesis 提出假设、test a hypothesis 检验假设、null hypothesis 零假设（统计）。复数 hypotheses，拼写与读音都变。派生：hypothetical adj. 假设的：a hypothetical question；hypothesize v. 假定，假定成立。
collocations: test a hypothesis 验证假说
put forward a hypothesis 提出假设
confirm a hypothesis 证实假说
words.mnemonic: hypo（次）+thesis（论点）→ 未定论的「次级论点」→ 假说

words.definition: vt. 召唤，传唤；召集；鼓起（勇气等）

examples.en: The court summoned three witnesses to testify at the trial.
examples.zh: 法庭传唤三名证人出庭作证。

examples.en: She summoned up all her courage before walking onto the stage.
examples.zh: 走上舞台之前，她鼓起了全部勇气。

words.usage: 正式用语：summon sb to a meeting 召见、summon the parliament 召集议会；法律语境 summon sb to appear in court 传唤出庭。高频短语 summon up courage or strength 鼓起勇气、鼓足力气。派生：summons n. 传票，法律术语。
collocations: summon up courage 鼓起勇气
summon a meeting 召集会议
summon sb to court 传唤出庭
words.mnemonic: 音似「萨满」→ 萨满作法召唤 → 传唤，召集

words.definition: adj. 相反的，反向的；n. 相反，对立面

examples.en: The study found an inverse relationship between income and reported stress.
examples.zh: 研究发现收入与自我报告的压力之间呈负相关。

examples.en: The new policy proved to be the exact inverse of what was promised.
examples.zh: 新政策被证明与当初的承诺恰恰相反。

words.usage: 数学统计高频：inverse proportion 反比、in inverse proportion to sth 与某物成反比，考研阅读常见表述。名词指反面、对立面：the inverse of sth。副词 inversely：be inversely related 负相关。派生：invert vt. 倒转；inversion n. 倒置。
collocations: in inverse proportion to 与…成反比
inverse relationship 反向关系
the inverse of sth 某物的反面
words.mnemonic: in（反）+verse（转）→ 反着转 → 相反的；invert 倒置

words.definition: vt. 无意中听到；碰巧听到

examples.en: I overheard them discussing the layoffs in the corridor.
examples.zh: 我在走廊里无意中听到他们谈论裁员的事。

examples.en: The reporters overheard the negotiators discussing the final terms.
examples.zh: 记者们偶然听到谈判代表讨论最终条款。

words.usage: overhear sb doing sth 无意中听见某人正在做某事，过去式 overheard，不规则。与 eavesdrop「故意偷听」相对：overhear 是偶然被动听见，eavesdrop 是蓄意偷听，语域差别常在完形中考。同族 over- 前缀：overlook 忽略、oversee 监督。
collocations: overhear a conversation 无意听到谈话
overhear sb say sth 偶然听见某人说
couldn't help overhearing 想不听都难
words.mnemonic: over（越过）+hear（听）→ 声音飘进耳朵 → 无意听到

words.definition: v. 腐烂，腐朽；腐败；n. 腐烂；颓败

examples.en: The fallen apples rotted quickly in the summer heat.
examples.zh: 掉落的苹果在盛夏高温中很快烂掉了。

examples.en: Graft and corruption rotted the regime from within.
examples.zh: 贪腐使这个政权从内部朽坏。

words.usage: 指有机物腐烂：The apples rotted。短语 rot away 烂掉、rot from within 由内而烂，常用于制度、组织的比喻。英式习语 the rot set in 局势开始恶化，stop the rot 扭转颓势。派生：rotten adj. 腐烂的；rotting adj. 正在腐烂的。
collocations: rot away 烂掉
stop the rot 制止颓势
rot from within 由内腐烂
words.mnemonic: rot→rotten 双写 t；音似「肉特」易烂
